object.name: answerInlineQuery
object.description:
Use this method to send answers to an inline query. On success, True is returned.
No more than 50 results per query are allowed.
object.html_description:
Use this method to send answers to an inline query. On success, True is returned.
No more than 50 results per query are allowed.
object.rst_description:
Use this method to send answers to an inline query. On success, :code:`True` is returned.

No more than **50** results per query are allowed.

annotations.name: inline_query_id
annotations.description: Unique identifier for the answered query
annotations.rst_description: Unique identifier for the answered query

annotations.name: results
annotations.description: A JSON-serialized Array of results for the inline query
annotations.html_description: A JSON-serialized Array of results for the inline query
annotations.rst_description: A JSON-serialized Array of results for the inline query

annotations.name: cache_time
annotations.description: The maximum amount of time in seconds that the result of the inline query may be cached on the server. Defaults to 300.
annotations.html_description: The maximum amount of time in seconds that the result of the inline query may be cached on the server. Defaults to 300.
annotations.rst_description: The maximum amount of time in seconds that the result of the inline query may be cached on the server. Defaults to 300.

annotations.name: is_personal
annotations.description: Pass True if results may be cached on the server side only for the user that sent the query. By default, results may be returned to any user who sends the same query.
annotations.html_description: Pass True if results may be cached on the server side only for the user that sent the query. By default, results may be returned to any user who sends the same query.
annotations.rst_description: Pass :code:`True` if results may be cached on the server side only for the user that sent the query. By default, results may be returned to any user who sends the same query.

annotations.name: next_offset
annotations.description: Pass the offset that a client should send in the next query with the same text to receive more results. Pass an empty string if there are no more results or if you don't support pagination. Offset length can't exceed 64 bytes.
annotations.html_description: Pass the offset that a client should send in the next query with the same text to receive more results. Pass an empty string if there are no more results or if you don't support pagination. Offset length can't exceed 64 bytes.
annotations.rst_description: Pass the offset that a client should send in the next query with the same text to receive more results. Pass an empty string if there are no more results or if you don't support pagination. Offset length can't exceed 64 bytes.

annotations.name: button
annotations.description: A JSON-serialized object describing a button to be shown above inline query results
annotations.html_description: A JSON-serialized object describing a button to be shown above inline query results
annotations.rst_description: A JSON-serialized object describing a button to be shown above inline query results
